The scorecard is the average of five dimensions, each scored from the platform own pages. Nothing in it is taken from testimonials, ads or the platform self-assigned rating.
whatItClaims: 8 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Open the signup page, enter your information and confirm the account by email.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Fund the account with US$250 - bank cards, transfer, PayPal and Skrill are accepted.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your limits, pick a trading mode and let the demo build your confidence first.

pros: Risk settings before the first trade.
A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
cons: One figure doing two different jobs.
redFlags: Performance language with no dates attached.
A broker relationship described in one vague sentence.
Ownership details missing from the public pages.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: Where is Sirgrit Investment restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: Is registration free?
faqs.a: Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
Our 4.0 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
